title: Post hoc cloud-feasible validation of fixed-threshold transfer and equal-review ranking
classification: Post hoc exploratory; settings fixed before these new computations, not an original-study preregistration
budget_calibration: Unique development score cutoffs plus zero-review option; risk>=cutoff; keep ties together; nearest target review fraction; equal distance chooses fewer reviews
equal_review: For each target use nearest integer patient count in the cohort, choosing fewer if exactly tied; risk descending, official string case ID as tie-break; report actual count

bootstrap.unit: patient; independent resampling within development/internal/external cohorts, paired A/B and labels retained
routes: fixed original cutoffs with test-cohort resampling
development calibration resampling with original test cohorts fixed
bootstrap.strict_original_direction_reversal: external B-minus-A detection >0 at fixed threshold AND <0 at equal-review; ties separate
bootstrap.intervals: descriptive percentile 95%; not substitutes for original Newcombe intervals
bootstrap.zero_denominators: NA; report count, do not impute

decomposition.standardization_weights: arithmetic mean of internal and external diagnostic-stratum weights; event weights for detection, all-patient weights for review

prohibited_inferences: post hoc promotion to a prespecified primary result
